description: Type text into an input/textarea element by its index (from session_state output), dispatching input/change events (full keyboard cycle per character with events:"full"). A disabled, readonly, or detached field answers `filled:false` with a `reason` instead of a silent write. Hidden inputs are legitimate targets and are filled normally.

events.description:
Event fidelity: "full" types one character at a time with a
keydown/keypress/input/keyup cycle per character, for pages whose
listeners key on keyboard events (e.g. keypress-Enter login forms).
Default fires a single input+change pair after the value is set.

text.description: Text to type into the input field

name: session_input
